scenes.heading: Growing an engaged audience, not just a large one

sents.d: Growing an engaged audience, not just a large one
A smaller, engaged audience often monetizes better than a larger passive one.

Brands and platforms increasingly weigh engagement rate alongside raw follower count, since a smaller but genuinely engaged audience often converts better for sponsorships and product sales than a much larger passive one.

Responding to comments and messages, especially early in building an audience, signals to both the algorithm and your actual audience that engagement is genuine and reciprocated, which tends to deepen loyalty over time.

Chasing follower count through tactics that don't attract a genuinely interested audience (engagement bait, follower-for-follower schemes) usually hurts long-term engagement rate and can make brand partnerships harder to land credibly later.

take: Grow an engaged audience, not just a big one.
